collection.title: Audi A3 Sportback 2020 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit an Audi A3 Sportback 2020 Onwards which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Specific Audi Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this A3 which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
